name: line-kakeibo-bot
description: LINE Receipt Bot for Household Budget

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-expense-card.js && node scripts/smoke-text-parser.js && node scripts/smoke-gmail-parse.js && node scripts/smoke-admin-auth.js && node scripts/smoke-expense-group-scope.js && node scripts/smoke-household-api.js && node scripts/smoke-recurring.js && node scripts/smoke-settlement-summary.js && node scripts/smoke-classifier.js && node scripts/smoke-gemini-client.js && node scripts/smoke-jev-classifier.js && node scripts/smoke-taxonomy.js && node scripts/smoke-eval-hierarchy.js
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase --config scripts/firebase.emulator.json emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-kakeibo "node scripts/emulator-household-api.js && node scripts/emulator-recurring.js && node scripts/emulator-settlement-summary.js"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
